correctness.rationale: Complementary level-k blocks have signed total (b-2)^k. Exact prefix-extrema recurrences prove H_k=sum_{j=0}^k (b-2)^j and the required minimum. Both opposite parent bigrams occur, so the extremal signed factors +/- (2H_k-D_k) occur. Sliding-window changes of one-count by at most one fill the entire interval. The case k=0 is checked separately. Direct independent finite verification covers 42 base-level pairs with complete two-block windows.
